findings.title: Run validator accepts an empty replacement source map and unbound process evidence
findings.evidence: Empty before/after maps plus sourceFiles=0 are accepted with pins=465. CLI exit0 and controls PASS. durationMs=6001, missing durationMs, altered limits, forged argv/cwd/env/PID/PGID and concealed nonempty stderr also pass check_run+evaluate. Duration variant independently passes full CLI.
findings.impact: OBS-SBX-04 cannot reject source sentinel removal, unverified launch provenance, unknown/out-of-limit duration, or concealed stream evidence. These are observer defects, not proof that the actual pinned runs were forged.
findings.requiredRevision: Bind run membership/digests to trusted frozen authority and verify expected process/stream schemas, identity, duration, limits, and actual stderr evidence in test support. Do not alter production.

findings.title: Observation validator accepts lost telemetry and forged causal payloads
findings.evidence: Telemetry can be [] or arbitrary malformed objects; full CLI still returns exit0 for lost telemetry. Tool log identity/input/key/correlation, body tenant/agent/signal, direct gate policy flags, decision input, and a fabricated 64-hex fingerprint also pass. Duplicate JSON keys and boolean counters pass. Updated copied stdout hashes rule out a trivial checksum mismatch as the explanation.
findings.impact: OBS-SBX-04 requires adulterated evidence rejection; current checks preserve event topology but do not authenticate the full recorded meaning. Correct counters alone cannot establish truthful causal logs or metadata.
findings.requiredRevision: Validate required native event payloads/types and links, recompute composition fingerprint, reject ambiguous JSON and boolean numeric counters, and add copied-evidence rejection controls. Test support only.

findings.title: Execution deadline ceases to be enforced when both pipes reach EOF
findings.evidence: The 5s check is inside while selector.get_map(). After both pipes close, child.wait(timeout=2) grants a fresh 2s without comparing elapsed time. A child that closes both streams at 4.9s and exits at 5.4s takes the success branch, with violation=None. The success predicate never checks durationMs. Static control-flow finding; no altered probe or OS timing experiment executed.
findings.impact: The advertised 5s execution bound can be exceeded without rejection; distinct from permitted post-kill cleanup time.
findings.requiredRevision: Use the remaining absolute execution deadline for join after EOF and record a deadline violation when execution exceeds it. Keep teardown time separately identified.

findings.title: Unexpected launcher errors can bypass cleanup and final evidence persistence
findings.evidence: There is no enclosing try/finally after Popen. An os.read/selector error bypasses kill/join and stream persistence. An after-snapshot digest/read error raises after stream writes but before sources-after/process.json; process outcome and teardown record are then missing. killpg in the join-timeout branch also lacks the ProcessLookupError protection used in the earlier branch. Static only; no filesystem fault or source mutation introduced.
findings.impact: The promise that failure retains bounded streams, exit/join and source evidence does not cover these failure paths.
findings.requiredRevision: Make post-spawn cleanup unconditional and persist partial streams plus explicit error/unknown snapshot metadata even if capture or hashing fails. Reject incomplete runs; do not change production.
